status: UNCONSTRAINED DESIGN SEARCH. Canon set aside at kT's request (2026-10-24); physics kept. Every assumption below is authored and visible. Not canon, not engineering.

fixed_modules.note: habitat, service region and aft torch chain are kept as in the repo reference; only the midship changes

fluids.note: protected water now lives in the main tanks for every layout, so all are judged on 315 m3

c_tank_penalty_t.note: assumed extra shell mass for non-round pressure vessels

SADDLE.label: Two saddle tanks, shuttle on top

CWRAP_G.label: Wrap-around tanks with strake grooves, shuttle on axis

c_tank_penalty_t.note: assumed extra shell mass for non-round pressure vessels

CWRAP_G.groove_note: four 2 m x 0.5 m grooves cut along the diagonals so accordion strakes stow flush; costs 4 m2 of tank section per metre (authored)

plant.axis_note: AXIS sits in the gaps around four round tanks, as in the repo reference
plant.keel_note: KEEL sits below the shuttle or tanks; centroid heights are authored estimates per layout

plant_fins.note: SHARED means the plant dumps heat through the main radiators as today. A dedicated set lets Metric up to that mode run with the big radiators folded. Fins overlapping the main radiator roots get a view-factor warning, not a rejection.
plant_fins.placement: diagonals (45/135/225/315 deg) at each plant block; 4 fins per block; diagonals keep clear of the cardinal main radiators, the vertical shuttle exit and the side drop tanks

drop_tanks.note: two tanks on the sides; placed as close to the mass centre as clearances allow

mass_rules.note: structure scales with ship length; the other repo seed ledger lines keep their mass and move with their module (RCS and reserve with the ship's middle)

score_weights.note: superseded by roles in v0.2 analysis; kept for the record

metric_fold.source: repo geometry compiler placeholder panel span (OPEN)
metric_fold.note: radius the Metric field must clear in NORMAL and FAST, from whatever panels are out in that mode

courier.note: base hull, drop tanks off; what Metric and Loom see

long_haul.note: drop-tank kit on the chosen hull

heat_notes.SHARED: plant heat through the main radiators, fully deployed for Metric (today)
heat_notes.SHARED_PARTIAL: main radiators deploy only as far as the Metric mode needs
heat_notes.FINS_BLOCKS: dedicated fins at every plant block
heat_notes.FINS_FORE: split plant only: all dedicated fins at the fore block; aft half's heat is piped forward past the bay
heat_notes.FINS_FORE_MAIN_PARTIAL: split plant only: fore fins take the fore half, main radiators partly deployed take the aft half

search_v0_2.rule: plant fins overlapping the main radiator roots (plus clearance) are rejected, not warned
